acceptance: scripts/canary_impact.py implements every dependency and fail-safe rule above and emits the JSON contract with per-test reasons.
A unit test asserts every collected canary test file has at least one dependency edge.

Unit tests cover each rule with a minimal fixture tree: parent __init__, importlib literal, REPO_ROOT path join, with_name, directory dependency, pytest_plugins, same-directory data file, self-selection, unresolvable dynamic edge, each whole-suite trigger, and an unmapped path.
A test replays the four known-regression commits above and asserts the failing test is selected for each.

context:
Prior art to read first and reuse or extend rather than duplicate: _project/scripts/report_slow_test_coverage.py (added in #2313, reports slow-tier coverage in nightly), scripts/path_filter_decision.py and .github/path-filters.yml (changed-path classification), scripts/heavy_tier_needed.py (fail-closed tier decision pattern), scripts/release_canary_sharding.py (canonical canary collection).

Guardrails:
1. When unsure, select. The selector may over-select; it must never under-select silently. Every uncertainty (parse error, unresolvable edge, unknown path, collection failure) resolves toward running more tests, and the reason is recorded in the output.
2. Use the same marker expression and collection as release-canary.yml; import it, do not copy it. A test fails if they diverge.
3. Stdlib-only and read-only: the selector must not import benchbox or execute test code.
4. The can't-affect-canary list is a reviewed constant with a comment per entry; adding to it needs a stated reason in the PR.
5. No CI wiring in this item.

Known-regression fixtures (the selector must select the failing test for each): #2250 (68fb5a071) -> tests/integration/test_tpcdi_full_benchmark.py; #2247 (5e9284a2c) -> tests/unit/core/flightdata/test_flightdata_benchmark_resource_heavy.py; #2199 (ed3e39a9c) and #2206 (2384c3ee7) -> tests/unit/scripts/test_validate_submission_resource_heavy.py. A static-import prototype selected all of these, but it resolved only leaf modules and missed pytest_plugins, dynamic imports, computed paths, and docs; do not treat its numbers as validation.
